definition: שִׁילֹה Gen 49:10 , apparently noun , but probably = שֶׁלּוֺ he whose it is , or that which belongs to him , see infra; views are: (1) שִׁיל (= שָׁלִיל , Late Hebrew embryo , + suffix הֹ֯ = his son , ᵑ7 Jerome Rabb Calv ); (2) שִׁלוּ , שִׁילוֺ proper name, of a location (q. v.) Herder De and most (until recently); (3) proper name of Messiah, AV RV Münster (1534) on basis of Talmud Sanh 98:b; groundless; (4) Jerome שׁלה = שָׁלֻחַ , qui mittendus est ; (5) שֶׁלֹּה = לוֺ + שֶׁ , ᵑ7 Onk whose is the kingdom , ᵑ6 whose it is , so Aphr Ephr ᵐ5 ἕως ἂν ἔλθῃ τὰ ἀποκείμενα αὐτῷ (Manuscripts ᾧ ἀπόκειται ); so Samaritan שלה , compare אֲשֶׁר לוֺ הַמִּשְׁפָּט Ezek 21:32 , Aq Symm Theod Saad ; this reading best, but exact translation not certain; see Dr JPhil. xiv (1885), 1 ff. Gn. 418 ff. Br MP 95 ff., intr. 238 ff. Poznanvski Schiloh (1904) . שׁילל see שׁלל .
